description: arXiv:2610.11008v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Language-model agents favor their own group because they have watched their members favor each other. The group label alone does little once the decision has a cost; what drives favoritism is observed behavior, and an individual's own record can override it. We test this in small societies with arbitrary group labels, ten rounds of point sharing...
